description: This file contains functions related to managing and resolving configured bindings within a plugin system, including registry priming, resolution by conversation or session key, and materialization of bindings.

methods.name: resolveMaterializedConfiguredBinding
methods.description: Resolves and materializes a configured binding based on the provided conversation reference and configuration.

methods.name: primeConfiguredBindingRegistry
methods.description: Primes the binding registry and returns counts of bindings and channels.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredBindingRecord
methods.description: Resolves a binding record based on configuration, channel, account, and conversation IDs.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredBindingRecordForConversation
methods.description: Resolves a binding record for a specific conversation reference.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredBinding
methods.description: Resolves a configured binding including its match and rule details.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredBindingRecordBySessionKey
methods.description: Resolves a binding record using a session key.
